Seven comments

Nia’s Barndance

Written by Dermot Byrne and taught by him at Ceol Aneas 2018. A lovely tune with an addictive hook on the turn that takes you back for more. Nia and Dermot play it together here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VOw5MBdcdhw

↳ Posted by Alex Davidson on November 6th, 2018.
